title: Coming of Age/Quotes
summary:
"Someone needed to try a little anger management."
- Zhalia Moon, upon seeing the marks left by the battle between Eathon Lambert and The Professor's Personal Guard

"Hey, you look too hard, and you may miss the answer right in front of you."
-Lok Lambert

"These flames are an illusion. They will not harm you if you are courageous." (Atlantis Guardian)

"I don't care if it is real fire, if it means finding my dad, I'll walk through it no matter what!" (Lok Lambert)

"I'm sensing a strange power. Is this part of the test?" (Sophie Casterwill)

"I don't think so. I think it's part of Lok." (Dante Vale)

"Go easy on 'em, Dante."
- Zhalia Moon right before Dante Vale begins the Test of Prowess

"You don't appear to be Titans. Too bad for you."
- Dante Vale to the Mermen

"There is no equivalent power to a Legendary Titan. Trying to copy it is a bad idea."
- Dante Vale

"Wow, Dante! I didn't even think it was possible to invoke Caliban, Metagolem and Behemoth back to back like that." (Lok Lambert)

"It's not." (Dante Vale, before collapsing from exhaustion)

"You've got to be more careful! You wouldn't see me doing that."
- Cherit to Zhalia Moon, after she runs into the force barrier

"Okay, just get it over with." (Zhalia Moon)

"Young miss, you look uneasy. Is there something the matter?" (Atlantis Guardian)

"Maybe because I'm not noble. I was born poor. I lied, bullied, cheated and stole my way up in the world. I even betrayed the only people who were ever good to me." (Zhalia Moon)

"You don't need royal blood, or a spotless past. In order to pass you have to show inner nobility by being honest even if it hurts, which you have. You pass. (Atlantis Guardian)

"I barely remember how to open this cumbersome thing. It has been ten thousand years."
- Atlantis Guardian

"I've come for the Amulet of Will. No exceptions."
- Rassimov to the Huntik team

"[My] dad never made it past the battle. It's because of the Organization. It's because of you!"
- Lok Lambert to Rassimov

"What's gotten into Lok?"
- Cherit to Sophie Casterwill

"I'm about to change my mind. Rassimov's going to be my friend in five seconds. Five, four... now!"
- Lok Lambert to the Atlantis Guardian, ordering it to open the gates so that Lindorm can strike Rassimov

"Lok Lambert, your luck has run out." (Rassimov)

"Wrong, I still have my father's amulet." (Lok Lambert, before invoking Baselaird)

"Go ahead. Invoke something. The more you throw at me, the more Baselaird will throw at you."
- Lok Lambert to Rassimov

"Lok is starting to show his true potential."
- Dante Vale on Lok Lambert overpowering Rassimov

"I've been making a complete fool out of myself, haven't I? Jumping around shouting 'I know my dad's right around the corner!'. I don't how you put up with me." (Lok Lambert)

"Don't say that! Your energy is what keeps all of us going. At least, well, you're the one who keeps me going." (Sophie Casterwill)

"So, where do we go now?" (Lok Lambert)

"Lok, the amulet is right in front of us, but only you can get it. You can't find your father now, but don't forget, he left for a reason, for a goal." (Sophie Casterwill)
